description: Constant-energy MD of 500 Cu atoms with MACE-MPA-0 (Float32, Metal) for 2 ps from 300 K velocities, one entry per time step

settings.noise: Philox4x32-10, one key per step from Xoshiro
settings.stable_if: completes with finite energies, |drift| <= 0.001 eV/atom/ps and RMS residual about the line <= 0.0005 eV/atom

md_float32_cpu_baseline.note: The device and the CPU baseline draw their noise from different generators (Philox and Xoshiro), so the runs are statistically independent.
